reuse.why: Extends the existing isMonthFillTarget/getMonthFillCategories selection that every month-wide action already uses, only adding goal_def to the queries that feed it.

duplication.why: The template rule is written once (hasSavedTemplates inside isMonthFillTarget); no logic is repeated.

placement.why: The new exclusion sits in the shared month-fill predicate in budget/actions.ts, where the hidden/income rules already live.

scope.why: Only the selection predicate, its scope type (dropping the now-unneeded 'all'), the goal_def column and tests change.

maintainability.why: A maintainer changes the 'which categories' rule in one predicate; the remaining 'visible'/'not-hidden' difference stays explicit as a named scope.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setZero, copyPreviousMonth and the average actions all go through isMonthFillTarget (directly or via getMonthFillCategories).

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; hasSavedTemplates is a single new helper.

one_place.where: isMonthFillTarget in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts (with hasSavedTemplates), used by getMonthFillCategories for setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg and directly by copyPreviousMonth.
